item: C-L3 offline SKOS reader + rule topic tagger + labelled-sample harness
summary: Offline SKOS RDF/XML reader (defusedxml; empty scheme and label-less concept are gaps), whole-word rule tagger with exact vs ≈ tiers (alt labels and shared labels are ≈), measure() on a labelled sample with approx share, null+reason for zero denominators; four optional registry entries (EuroVoc, UNESCO, AGROVOC, IPTC) absent until the licence fetch (E4) and P5437 confirmation. No data bundled, no network.
